blind_read: The monkey paced from side to side with its hands behind its back and a bulb shining on its cap.

evidence.observation: The feet cross and open while the hands remain tucked behind the belly. The cream cap and yellow bulb sit above the silhouette and stay legible on charcoal.
The head and cap reverse direction with the body and the tail follows behind. The bulb and cap keep their fixed colors through the teal return stride.
